transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Well… I’m here because things with my in-laws have gotten very hard. I know it may sound like family trouble, and I don’t want to make it seem bigger than it is, but it feels like more than arguing.

I really believe they’ve been using the altar and the parish committee to push me out… like they’re trying to make everyone forget what I’ve done for this family. I don’t know if I’m explaining that right.
Do you believe for certain that your in-laws are using the altar and parish committee against you?

I… yes, I do believe that. I know it probably sounds like I’m making too much of church matters, and I don’t want to seem unreasonable, but it feels very clear to me.

It wasn’t just arguing with me. I came in because I knew my in-laws were using the altar and the parish committee to push me out, like they wanted people to forget everything I’ve done for this family. I’m trying to explain it the right way.
Have you heard voices when no one was there?

I… I don’t want you to think I’m strange. But yes, on a few nights I heard my mother’s voice—my late mother—telling me where to put the marigolds and the candles. It felt very real at the time.

And once I thought I saw her by the kitchen doorway, but my husband said there was no one there. I know that sounds… not right, but that’s what happened.
Did these experiences start soon after a major stressful event?

I think so, yes… it was after that big fight with my in-laws about the Día de los Muertos altar. I don’t want to make it sound dramatic, but this whole thing has been going on for maybe about two months now, since then.
Aside from your in-laws, do you feel that other people are also trying to harm you or work against you?

I don’t know if I should say “other people,” exactly… I don’t want to accuse everyone. But it felt like it wasn’t only my in-laws talking badly about me. It felt like they were using the altar and the parish committee to push me out, to make everyone forget what I’ve done for this family.

I know that may sound like a lot, doctor, but that’s how it felt to me.
Have these experiences been going on for more than one month?

Yes… I think it has been more than a month. I don’t want to make too much of it, but this whole crisis has been going on for about two months now, since that fight with my in-laws over the Día de los Muertos altar.
Have these experiences been going on for three months or longer?
No, I don’t think it’s been three months. It’s felt long, but… more like about two months, since that fight with my in-laws over the Día de los Muertos altar. Does that sound right?
Have these experiences completely gone away at any point since they began?

No… I don’t think it’s completely gone away. It maybe feels quieter some days, and I try not to focus on it, but this whole crisis has still been there for about two months, since that fight with my in-laws over the Día de los Muertos altar. Is that… is that what you mean?
Even when your husband or others tell you this is not happening, are you still completely certain that your in-laws are using the altar and parish committee against you?

I know it sounds bad when I say it so plainly, and I don’t want to seem unreasonable… but yes, I’m still sure. I came in because it didn’t feel like just an argument with my in-laws. It felt like they were using the altar and the parish committee to push me out, to make everyone forget what I’ve done for this family. Is that… is that okay to say?
During this time, have you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day?

Yes… I mean, I don’t want to make it sound worse than it is, but after all that energy left me, I’ve been waking up with this heavy sadness. Most days it feels like there’s no joy left in my house, or in me. Is that what you mean by depressed?
During this time, have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?

I’m not sure… I mean, I still try to do the things I’m supposed to enjoy, like being around the family or keeping up with the house, but it doesn’t feel the same. I don’t know if I’d call it “lost interest” exactly… maybe more like I’m just going through the motions. Is that the kind of thing you’re asking?
Before the sadness started, was there a period when you felt unusually energetic or high?

Yes… before the sadness, there were days I felt very bright, almost too sure of everything. I don’t want to make it sound like I was out of control, but I had this energy and certainty in me. And if anyone questioned me about the altar, I would get sharp with them… snap at them, like they were insulting my whole family. Is that what you mean?
During that time when you felt unusually energetic, did you need much less sleep than usual?

Yes… not a normal amount, I guess. At first I was only sleeping a couple hours, but I’d still get up and start making lists, like I had things I needed to do. I didn’t really feel tired then, or I told myself I didn’t.

Now it’s different… I lie awake before dawn worrying, and even if I’ve been in bed, I don’t feel rested. Does that answer it the right way?
During that time when you felt unusually energetic, were you more active than usual in starting or doing things?

Yes… I think so. I mean, I told myself I was just being productive, trying to get things in order. But I really couldn’t stay still. I kept cleaning, calling people, rewriting menus, moving boxes of decorations around… even when everyone said I should sit down and rest.

It didn’t feel bad at the time, exactly. It felt like I was getting important things done. But looking back, I suppose it was more than usual. Is that what you mean?
When you heard your mother’s voice, was that during the time when you had all that extra energy?

Yes… I think that’s right. It was during that time, when I wasn’t really sleeping and I was rushing around, feeling like I had this duty to make the altar right.

I don’t want it to sound worse than it was, but… that’s when I heard her voice, and when I thought I saw my mother. After my mood dropped, I still felt terrible and guilty, but I wasn’t hearing or seeing those things anymore. Is that the kind of answer you mean?
